record.reason: Diff-ES searches stage-wise sparsity schedules for diffusion models by evolutionary search and executes them via memory-efficient weight routing without duplicating pruned models, achieving wall-clock speedups on DiT/SDXL; it is inference-oriented structured pruning, but for image diffusion models rather than LLMs.
record.title: Diff-ES: Stage-wise Structural Diffusion Pruning via Evolutionary Search
